snippet.title: Trailer - Forest of Deceit comes to Steam and consoles on July 13th
snippet.description:
Find the Traitors in Forest of Deceit, a social deduction Jackbox-esque game for 4-8 players: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2388580/Forest_of_Deceit?utm_campaign=announcement&utm_content=trailer

A STORM IS COMING. If you can’t build shelter in a matter of days your entire group will perish. But the forest is cursed, and is driving some of your friends mad - now they’re trying to get you all killed. From the minds of Ghost Camp and Thomas Mackinnon (creator of THE CORRIDOR and It Takes a War) comes Forest of Deceit, a back-stabbing experience about trying to survive a storm and betraying your friends. With a beautiful hand-drawn art style and a focus on casual play and social interaction, this party game is perfect for all kinds - from teenagers to grandpas, hardcore players to someone who’s never played a game in their life.
